description: This file contains unit tests for GatewaySettingsStore, focusing on persistence and migration of gateway configuration data between defaults and keychain, as well as storing and retrieving API keys. It employs various helper functions to snapshot and restore user defaults and keychain entries, and tests different scenarios such as initial bootstrap, manual, and discovered gateway configurations.

classes.name: GatewaySettingsStoreTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests for GatewaySettingsStore's persistence logic.

methods.description: Tests that BootstrapPersistence correctly copies defaults to keychain when keychain entries are missing.

methods.name: bootstrapCopiesKeychainToDefaultsWhenMissing
methods.description: Tests that BootstrapPersistence correctly copies keychain values to defaults when defaults are missing.
